messages:
tara: Morning team — quick pulse on model-omega-v2 onboarding. I ran the promptset_ugc smoke eval overnight and saw a regression on the answer_relevance metric (~0.91 -> 0.84). Not blocked but want to sync on next steps.
alex: thanks for the heads up. do you have the eval command/output? can rerun locally.
tara: pasted the command and top lines of the failure below:
```
./run_eval --model model-omega-v2 --suite promptset_ugc --metrics answer_relevance,helpfulness --seed 42
Summary: answer_relevance: 0.84 (target >= 0.90)
Top failure case: prompt id 4521 — hallucinated entity when asked for invoice total
```
sam: linking the PR that changed the system prompt weight last week — might be correlated: https://git.redwood/repo/pull/5123
kai: I can take a look at the kvcache warmup; sometimes the sequence-length distribution shift reduces retrieval quality early in generation. I'll instrument cache hit rates on the canary.
eval-bot: automated-eval: model-omega-v2 @2178900800 -> answer_relevance: 0.84, helpfulness: 0.88. Diff vs baseline: -0.07, -0.01. Failing prompt ids: [4521, 4527, 4533].
alex: quick hypothesis — last quantize pass switched to 4bit-per-channel and we may be losing some entity tokens. I'm going to run a small compare between q4_0 and q8 on the failure prompts.
tara: thanks. if q8 fixes, can we do a canary with q8 variant for 10% traffic? would prefer a quick rollback if not.
sam: PR 5123 has the change log and test artifact, I'll add a repro prompt and smoke test.
kai: ETA for kvcache logs and canary config? I can add a canary route in infra, but need the variant name.
alex: running local compare now. will update in ~30m.
tara: blockers: none besides getting the canary variant name and the eval rerun. Today: triage failure cases, add 5 targeted prompts to gating suite, coordinate canary rollout. cc @sam for the PR change notes.
sam: will add the prompts and update gating config. also leaving a review on alex's compare PR.
alex: quick note: found that q8 reduces the regression to 0.89 on the subset. sharing diffs in the PR.
kai: created canary route: model-omega-v2-q8-canary, set to 10% and autoscale disabled for now. link: https://console.redwood/canaries/omega-q8
tara: perfect. once gating includes the 5 prompts and alex's PR lands, let's run a full overnight eval. if pass, we promote to 50% tomorrow morning.
eval-bot: scheduled job: full-suite eval queued at 2178930000. will post results here.
tara: thanks all — ping if anything blocks the canary rollout. :thumbsup:
